ART:User-Owner-Inventor-Manufacturer: An agent (Person, Organization, or GPE) that uses, owns, invents, or manufactures an artifact (Facility, Vehicle, or Weapon).
GEN-AFF:Citizen-Resident-Religion-Ethnic: A Person entity is a citizen of, resides in, or has a religious or ethnic affiliation with a GPE, Location, or Organization.
GEN-AFF:Org-Location: An Organization is located in, based in, or operates from a GPE or Location.
ORG-AFF:Employment: A Person is employed by an Organization, GPE, or other employer in a professional capacity.
ORG-AFF:Founder: A Person or Organization that founded or established another Organization.
ORG-AFF:Membership: A Person or Organization is a member of an Organization (not employment — e.g., political party membership, club membership).
ORG-AFF:Ownership: A Person owns an Organization, either wholly or partially.
ORG-AFF:Sports-Affiliation: A Person is affiliated with a sports Organization as a player, coach, or manager.
ORG-AFF:Student-Alum: A Person is a student or alumnus/alumna of an educational Organization.
ORG-AFF:Investor-Shareholder: A Person, Organization, or GPE holds an investment or shares in an Organization.
PART-WHOLE:Artifact: An artifact (Facility, Vehicle, or Weapon) is a component or part of another artifact.
PART-WHOLE:Geographical: A GPE, Location, or Facility is geographically contained within another GPE or Location.
PART-WHOLE:Subsidiary: An Organization is a subsidiary, branch, or sub-unit of another Organization.
PER-SOC:Business: Two Person entities have a professional or business relationship (e.g., business partners, co-workers outside of formal employment).
PER-SOC:Family: Two Person entities have a familial relationship (e.g., parent-child, siblings, spouse).
PER-SOC:Lasting-Personal: Two Person entities have a lasting personal relationship that is not familial or professional (e.g., friends, long-term associates).
PHYS:Located: A Person, Organization, or artifact entity is physically located at a specific Facility, Location, or GPE.
PHYS:Near: A Person, Organization, or artifact entity is physically near (but not at) a Facility, Location, or GPE.
